$comment: The harness CLI, machine-readable. tests/contract.test.ts fails when this list and src/cli.ts disagree, when a workflow uses a command or flag not marked stable, or when docs/contract.md omits a stable one. stable: true is covered by the compatibility promise in docs/contract.md; stable: false may change in a minor release.

commands.name: run
commands.summary: Start both stacks, capture, compare, claim, gate, report.

commands.name: compare
commands.summary: Re-run normalise/compare/claim/gate on captures already on disk.

commands.name: images
commands.summary: Pull each side's images, or build them from the monorepo ref.

commands.name: mutants
commands.summary: Build every mutant from the base reader image and prove the harness catches each.

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Harness version, git sha, contract version.

commands.name: stack
commands.summary: Start or stop both compose stacks.

exitCodes.0: verdict pass or warn; or the command succeeded
exitCodes.1: verdict fail; or images ensure, mutants or kind rollout did not succeed
exitCodes.2: usage error, or the harness itself failed (an uncaught error); no verdict was reached
